correctness.rationale: Proved exhaustive classification of square-zero 2x2 matrices into line-kernel fibers and determinant shifts by trace(A N). Nonzero determinant shifts occur bijectively on noninvariant lines, yielding both exact fibers. Discriminant/trace classification then counts all diagonalizable perturbations in every characteristic; all arithmetic and scalar exceptions explicitly checked. 7475 matrices and 400307 perturbation pairs independently enumerated with actual standalone source for six field sizes; general proof does not rest on experiments.

evidence: The 2025 article proves existence for larger matrix orders and odd fields; the indexed binary dimension-three record gives qualitative decomposition statistics in the separate order-three problem; torsion-unit fibers concern a different class of summands.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Higher-dimension existence neither determines 2x2 fiber sizes nor dominates them; a torsion-unit may be non-diagonalizable or invertible while a diagonalizable part need not be invertible. Nilpotent in 2x2 is square-zero but the allowed first summands are different.
searches: The number of diagonalizable-plus-square-zero decompositions of 2x2 matrices over even finite fields, parameter-independent fibers and rank-one nilpotent cone.

evidence: Proposition 2.2 in 2026 gives a single constructed split summand; the 2025 source states the older universal existence theorem for order two and its own larger-order existence theorem.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The current theorem supplies q-dependent exact cardinalities and determinant fibers not computable from mere existence claims. The 2022 complete text was unavailable; its existence statement alone does not entail those enumerations, but its full contents could reveal additional coverage.

evidence: The characteristic-two primary paper Proposition 2.2 constructs at least one summand per matrix; the 2025 original article quotes the older order-two existence theorem, not a counting formula.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Counting the fiber of determinant under all square-zero perturbations is equivalent to enumerating all perturbations with given characteristic polynomial at fixed trace. Read source results establish decomposability, not an equality of cardinalities. A possible unindexed equivalent formulation remains a risk.
searches: For 2 by 2 matrices over F_{2^m}, exactly q(q+1)/2 square-zero perturbations yield diagonalizable matrices when trace nonzero; trace zero exactly one.
The number of diagonalizable-plus-square-zero decompositions of 2x2 matrices over even finite fields, parameter-independent fibers and rank-one nilpotent cone.

evidence: The surfaced order-three binary result counts decomposable similarity classes and the factorization result counts ordered products, not determinant-resolved additive square-zero fibers.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: No located table with both invariant-line parameter and arbitrary target determinant supports all field sizes. This absence alone is not a novelty proof; it is assessed together with the inspected primary texts and direct implication comparisons.
searches: Enumerate square-zero nilpotent matrices with A+N split semisimple; characteristic 2 trace determinant eigenline geometry, q(q+1)/2

originality.rationale: The read full-text 2026 and 2025 primary papers establish existence but do not determine exact square-zero determinant fibers or exhaustive decomposition counts for every 2x2 matrix. Public record summaries for three closest findings concern different dimensions or different operations/summands. Residual access and unindexed-equivalence risks are explicit.
residual_risks: The complete 2022 predecessor article could contain uninspected enumeration statements; its 2x2 existence theorem is quoted in an inspected later full-text paper.
An equivalent determinant-fiber formula may be published under nilpotent perturbation, invariant-line, or matrix pencil terminology but not indexed by the searches.
Only summaries of the three closest indexed records were obtainable; they were not falsely treated as full-text inspections.

value.rationale: Determines the natural entire conditional determinant distribution of square-zero perturbations and the complete number of all decompositions of arbitrary 2x2 matrices in every finite field. Strengthens a live literature-led qualitative existence problem quantitatively, with a sharp characteristic-two dichotomy and a structural four-class odd-characteristic law. The invariant-line decomposition is a motivated reusable structural explanation rather than a single small-field census.
